features: 【🖥️ Immersive 34” UltraWide Curved Display】Experience cinematic visuals on a 34-inch 21:9 UWQHD (3440×1440) VA panel with 1500R curvature that wraps around your field of view for deeper immersion in gaming, movies, and multitasking.

【⚡ Smooth Gaming Performance】Enjoy ultra-fluid gameplay with up to 120Hz refresh rate via DisplayPort and 1ms VRB response time, reducing motion blur and ghosting for fast-paced action and competitive gaming precision.
【🎮 AMD FreeSync Premium + HDR10】Eliminate screen tearing and stuttering with AMD FreeSync Premium while HDR10 support enhances contrast and highlights, delivering more realistic and vibrant visuals.
【🔌 Versatile Connectivity & Eye Care】Equipped with 2× HDMI 2.1, 1× DisplayPort 1.4, audio out and built-in 2W×2 speakers; Acer VisionCare technology reduces eye strain for extended usage comfort.

【🌈 Rich Colors & Wide Viewing Angles】Featuring sRGB 99% color gamut and 1.07 billion colors, the VA panel ensures vivid color accuracy with 178° wide viewing angles, ideal for content creation, entertainment, and productivity.
